purpose: End-to-end confirmation pack for Home All Areas, permanent address picker, public radius filtering, selected-user exception, city shops, favourites, ads, notifications and messages.
before_you_start: Deploy the current Lambda code, then sign in once with Account A and Account B.
Replace every __TOKEN_A__ / __TOKEN_B__ with that account's fresh browser localStorage ax_google_token. Do not put tokens in source control.
Replace __SUB_A__ / __SUB_B__ with each Google user sub. Account A is the viewer; Account B is 10–15 km away.
Create Account B's public feed/story, KYC-approved active shop and active product using the normal app UI before running Account A's read tests.
Copy one value from events at a time into the Lambda Console Test event field; do not invoke the entire file at once.
pass_rules: At 5 km: Account B must be absent from geo users, public feed/stories, catalogue products and shop directory if B's saved Personal Information map pin is outside 5 km.
At 10 km: Account B appears only if its permanent Personal Information pin is at most 10 km away. Changing a device GPS/delivery address must not change results.

Selected post exception: an out-of-radius post appears only after both accounts follow each other AND Account B explicitly selects Account A. A public or followers-only post remains hidden outside the radius.
Top Shops and Star Performers use Account A's Personal Information city and remain unchanged when the radius changes. Favourites and admin-controlled ads are never radius filtered.
All Area address picker calls profile/update. Its address, city, pincode and pin must appear in GET /profile; an existing shop must mirror the same pickup address.

A_update_personal_address.expect: 200 + success:true; profile returns the exact address and coordinates.

A_set_5_km.expect: 200 + feed_geo.radius_km = 5; response lat/lng are Account A Personal Information pin, not device GPS.

A_5km_users.expect: Account B is absent when B is 10–15 km away.

A_5km_public_feed.expect: Account B public post is absent; any post with missing permanent pin is also absent.

A_5km_stories.expect: Account B public story is absent outside 5 km.

A_5km_catalogue.expect: Account B product is absent outside 5 km.

A_5km_shop_directory.expect: Account B KYC-approved shop is absent outside 5 km.

A_set_10_km.expect: 200 + feed_geo.radius_km = 10; repeat the four 5km read tests and Account B appears only when truly within 10 km.

A_follow_B.expect: 200; Account A now follows Account B.

B_follow_A.expect: 200; mutual follow relationship is now present.

B_create_selected_post.expect: 200; capture the returned post_id. Set Account A back to 5 km, then A_5km_public_feed must include this selected post despite B being outside radius.

A_city_top_shops.expect: Only KYC-approved shops in Account A's Personal Information city; same result at 5 km and 10 km.

A_favourite_products.expect: A liked Account B product remains here even when it is outside 5 km.

A_favourite_shops.expect: A liked Account B shop remains here even when it is outside 5 km.

A_admin_ad_unchanged.expect: Same admin-controlled advertisement at 5 km, 10 km and All Areas.

A_clear_radius.expect: 200; Home returns to All Areas while address remains unchanged in Personal Information.
